constraints: If folder is omitted, returns the pathname of the active 4D folder of the current application.
options is only taken into account when folder designates the '4D Client database folder' constant; it is ignored otherwise.

The optional * parameter only has an effect, when called from a component, for the 'Database folder', 'Database folder Unix syntax', and 'Current resources folder' constants (returning the host database's folder instead of the component's); it is ignored for all other folder values and when called from the host database.
When called from a remote 4D, the path returned is that of the remote machine, not of 4D Server.
Executing this command with the 'Current resources folder' or 'Logs folder' constant creates that folder if it does not already exist.
